notes: Requested hiphil "make light of; despise" has zero attestation under H2151 itself -- this root's own corpus attestations are only qal and niphal. The lexicon cross-references H2107 (זוּל, "probably to shake out ... figuratively, to treat lightly" -- explicitly "compare H2151"), which supplies exactly the missing hiphil (Lam.1.8, "הִזִּילוּהָ", "all that honoured her despise her"), the same suppletion pattern used for הלך/ילך, נוח/ינח, and סוג/נסג. Modeled as strong_alt: ["H2107"], with the hiphil form drawn from that number. Unlike the recent סוג/נסג restructuring, H2107 was not given its own file here, since (unlike H5253) it has only 2 sparse forms total (1 hiphil, 1 qal) rather than a full independent paradigm -- folded directly into this file instead, matching the original הלך/נוח convention.
